svg.title: How a read escalates: plain HTTP, TLS impersonation, a JavaScript renderer, then a real browser. The result is assessed after every step and the read stops at the first step that yields the page.
svg.text: Each read climbs only as far as the page needs
It stops at the first step that yields the page. Steps that cannot help are skipped, and every step has a deadline.
WHICHEVER STEP READS THE PAGE, THE RESULT CARRIES
ok, thin, partial or failed, and why
every attempt, tier, timing and hash
the exact next call when something is missing
